{Darth Vader} wades {Inside} the {Pool}, breathing so loudly that every swimmer flees and leaves him **alone**. {Pikachu} cowers in the {Bathroom} of the {Spa}, cheeks fizzing, for the one thing he **fears** is a Poké Ball. {Darth Vader} breathes loudly in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} as a *bow* twangs by itself and fires a **bullet** of soap at his helmet. He halts it in midair with one raised glove. {Shrek} roars from the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} because somebody has opened a **school** in it, and he only wanted some peace. {James Bond} strolls through the {Basement} of the {Piazza} and nods to a *standing person* who turns out to be a **fake**, a rubber dummy of himself. {James Bond}, rolled in a *blanket* in the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel}, checks his watch: the villain's speech has gone on very **long**. {Yoshi} follows a trail of *water drops* {Inside} the {Mint} to a *cliff spring* gushing between the coin presses. {Lara Croft} climbs {Inside} the {Tower}, where an ancient puzzle demands that a hundred stone blocks be moved, and a worn-out *labourer* simply hands her his shovel. {Pikachu} crackles {Inside} the {Island} and his static makes every spoon, nail and teapot **line up** in a neat row. {Naruto} bursts through the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} into an *inner room*, where a tiny old ninja lowers a bowl of ramen on a *silk thread*. {James Bond} strolls through the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} as the **police** storm in, and he gives them an unruffled *salute*. {Homer} hatches a dim scheme in the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} to **obtain** the last doughnut: crawl through the *grass* growing over the floor and snatch it. {Mario} bounds {Inside} the {Fort} and finds a perfect **model** of his whole world on a table: a wee *tree*, a painted *sunset*, tiny warp pipes. {Charlie Brown} stands in {Front} of the {Lagoon} trying to **fill** a *balloon*, puffing until his zigzag shirt strains. {Frodo} staggers through the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} under a *backpack* heavier than any hobbit should **bear**, with the Ring growing heavier at his neck. {Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Dunes} and finds a *cloud* lying on the sand, wheezing. His tongue flicks out, slurps it down like candyfloss, and a moment later he lays it as a soft white egg. {Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} on a vine with his jungle yell, baffled by the ropes. {Mario} plunges a blocked drain in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, and out shoots a *tree*, growing as fast as if it had swallowed a mushroom. He stomps on it and it grows more. 'Wahoo!' {Yoshi} leads a **tour** {Inside} the {Boathouse}, holding a *streamer* in his teeth, with *water drops* pattering on the visitors. {Lara Croft} dives {Inside} the {Lagoon} after a relic, and it turns out to be the tooth of a sleeping *dragon*. {Sherlock} examines a *tree* growing in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and deduces from one crumb of bark that *dance partners* have waltzed around it all night. {Yoshi} digs {Inside} the {Beach} and finds an egg he does not remember laying, with a *puzzled face* peering out of the crack. He starts to **doubt** everything: did he swallow a melon, a shoe, a seagull? 'Yoshi?' he asks, and his tongue creeps out and tests the shell in **doubt**.

{Cookie Monster} crashes {Inside} the {Jungle} to a cake as high as the palms, **layer** upon **layer**, with a *lying man* snoring on top under a *cloud* of icing sugar. {Lara Croft} drops into the {Basement} of the {Jungle}, teeth chattering, where a stone *herald* blows a horn to announce the **cold**. The {Joker} cackles in {Front} of the {Boathouse} with a stolen map and his squirting flower. {Charlie Brown} starts his **rush** in {Front} of the {Lagoon}, charging over crunching *icicles* at a football set on a painted *bullseye*. Lucy pulls it away, as always, and he flies up, hangs in the air and lands flat on his back. 'Good grief', he says, then he gets up to **rush** at it again.

{Sherlock} sniffs one feather in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and deduces that a hidden *archer* is about to **shoot** a rubber sucker at him. {Lara Croft} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Ice Rink} and scratches the rough **outline** of a lost tomb on the frosty wall: a *rice field*, a path, one big X. A confused *visitor* asks for details, but she only flips away, calling that the **outline** will do. The boulder she forgot to draw rolls out after the *visitor*.

{Frodo} wades barefoot through the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, where a *flood* swirls round tufts of *grass*, and the Ring whispers to him to give up. He trudges on, weary and loyal, and Sam points him out to the watching hobbit children as a **model** of patience. All of them copy him, tiny hairy feet in a row behind their **model**.

{James Bond} adjusts his tuxedo in the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring} just as the grand *finale* of the villain's scheme goes off, **unexpectedly**, ten minutes early. {James Bond} tumbles through a window into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, lands in the tub and delivers his one-liner, a single unruffled **sentence**. Q's pen, which does nothing else, records it and frames it as a *quotation* that the curators hurry to hang on the wall. He says another **sentence**, and they run for more frames.

{Sherlock} raps on the wax in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and deduces, from one crumb, a hidden **room**. A tiny *roof* lifts off like a lid, an *arrow landing* on the floor quivers to show the way, and there is the secret **room**, with Watson in it, covered in honey and looking sorry.

{Yoshi} slurps up a *cobra* in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and lays an egg, but out of the shell comes a tuft of *grass*, something totally **different**. Puzzled, he swallows the *grass* and lays again, and this time out hops a small hissing teapot, **different** yet again. 'Yoshi?' he asks it.

{James Bond} strolls in {Front} of the {Beach}, where the whole crowd is snoring, and presses a cufflink from Q that flicks icy *water drops* with a dazzling *sparkle* into every ear. {Homer} naps in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} on a history book about the **Han** dynasty, dribbling *water drops* onto the emperors. {Cookie Monster} discovers a tiny **village** in {Front} of the {Casino}, all gingerbread huts round one sugar *tree*. {Homer} tugs at a doughnut tin in {Front} of the {Spa}, its *fitted lid* stuck fast. He heaves, it pops, and the tin flies straight into his own wide-open *mouth*, doughnuts and all. 'D'oh!' he gargles, and young Nelson strolls by, points a finger and says **ha**, then **ha** once more.

{Cookie Monster} scratches a **plan** on a slip of *bamboo* with a *thorn* in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, tongue out, googly eyes crossed. Step one: find cookie. Step two: 'Me want cookie!' Then he gets hungry, and in a spray of crumbs he eats the *bamboo*, the *thorn* and the whole **plan**.

{Yoshi} steps onto a little stage in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} to **perform** the only act he knows. He gulps down a *temple arrow*, flutter-jumps through a curtain of *water drops*, and lays an egg that splits to reveal the arrow, while the crowd roars. He will **perform** it twice nightly.

{James Bond} faces a giant safe in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} with its hundred dials, and Q has given him one gadget: a stick of *bamboo*. {Kermit} hops around the {Basement} of the {Spa} holding up a cue **card**, flailing, while the show *upstairs* collapses with a great thump. {Darth Vader} stands in {Front} of the {Mansion} as a *sunrise* gleams on his helmet, and he refuses to **carry** the luggage like a common butler. The {Joker} unrolls a map in {Front} of the {Boathouse} and declares his own **state** of nonsense, with a playing card for its flag. {James Bond} sits perfectly **calm** in the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring} with a drink while a *tug of war* rages around him. {Yoshi} stretches his tongue in {Front} of the {Beach} and snatches a sunbather's *robe*, then every item of **clothes** on the washing line, and swallows the lot. He lays one enormous egg. {James Bond} lounges in {Front} of the {Beach} in a tuxedo with Q's new pocket magnet, which attracts straw and nothing else.
